name: Optics and Photonics
description: Geometrical optics, Fermat’s principle, ray equation and applications. Wave propagation, review of Maxwell’s equations and propagation of waves, plane polarized light. Reflection and refraction, Brewster angle; total internal reflection and evanescent waves. Reflection by a conducting medium. Interference by division of wavefront and amplitude; Stoke’s relations; reflecting and nonreflecting films; colors of thin films. Michelson and Fabry-Perot interferometer and etalon, Fresnel and Fraunhofer diffraction. Single slit, circular aperture; limit of resolution. Double slit, diffraction grating, resolving power. Fresnel half-period zones, zone plate. Diffraction of a Gaussian beam. Fourier optics: spatial-frequency filtering, phase contrast microscope. Holography principles, principles of laser, Einstein coefficients, cavity and stability.
